body: Laid out the two pending SPEC amendments for the user with options and recommendations. **No selection made yet** - the user was asked and has not answered, so nothing is recorded as a decision.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Measurement, so it is not re-derived.** `command grep -rniE '\bfork'` returns **0** across `~/.claude/rules`, `~/.claude/agents`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.claude/skills`. All six rules files that survive SPEC section 5.2 (pillars, no-comments, no-direct-db-access, coding-style, security, memory-discipline) individually return 0.U+000AU+000AThat reframes amendment 2 materially. Fork routing exists only in the SPEC, which lives outside the config, so there is nothing to remove - the proposed section 8 check is a tripwire against a future addition, not cleanup, and its baseline is already green. It can land as an acceptance check with zero remediation work attached.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Amendment 1 - reviewer criteria hole.** Section 6.2 gives both reviewers the invariant "a diff exists", which checks the artifact and not the criteria. A brief naming criteria that only resolve in the conversation passes, and the agent reviews against invented standards - the 13-rework-agent loop re-entered through the one open door. The fork decision widened this, because a caller with conversational criteria no longer has anywhere else to put them.U+000AU+000AOptions put to the user: (A) extend the invariant to "every standard **named in the brief** resolves to a path", class M because it halts; (B) nothing, relying on conformance-auditor already requiring resolvable paths; (C) an output field reporting which standards were applied, class A and therefore advisory per section 10.2. **Recommended A.** The wording is load-bearing: a brief naming no standard passes, and that vacuous pass is correct semantics here rather than a hole, because a review with no named standard is a general review against the always-on rules the subagent does receive.U+000AU+000AHonest limit stated to the user: section 8.8 checks that `1. Entry invariant` appears once per agent file but does not check what the invariant says, so amendment 1 is enforced at runtime by the halt and is unaudited in the body.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Amendment 2 - fork tripwire.** Options: (A) bare-word grep over rules, agents and CLAUDE.md; (A+) the same extended to `~/.claude/skills`; (B) skip; (C) match routing phrasings instead. **Recommended A+.** Extension to skills is free given the 0 baseline, and it closes a future `committing-work` or `reviewing-code` skill reintroducing fork as procedure; section 8.7 already walks that directory, so the scope has precedent. C was rejected on the SPEC's own section 0.3 grounds - a pattern list is a sampled allowlist, the shape `testing.md` names a change-detector in a census costume.U+000AU+000ABoth are single-line SPEC edits landing in the same commit as decision 01M29VKF0SNZWPK2B561ZFSVTK, so adopting either costs no extra round.
